_about: Candidates B and C of the small crude tower (P4, decision D4), trays numbered as the player reads them (condenser 1, sump = tray_count). A is built in SmallColumn.candidateA from medium_crude.json / 64. Top pressure, condenser temperature, reflux ratio and design feed are A's. Steam keeps A's 0.0614 kg per kg of bottoms on A's residue plus its gas oil (5459 + 589 kg/h), 371.5 kg/h. Pumparound heat is A's 0.740 MW regrouped. Since the parent's targets (2026-11-12): B and C aim at the barrel's shares; reflux 1.5 keeps the top vapour of the 4.17 designs at twice the overhead; steam keeps 0.0614 kg per kg on a 47 % bottoms (14.37 kmol/h); the heater limit is 4 MW and its outlet 390 C (sheet choices). C0 and C1 are the first round (A's rates). tuning.json holds every tuning solve.
